author_scope: Disclosed post-fix regression. Includes all 48 previously observed v7 cases and all 24 observed v10 source-aware challenge cases; not blind or independent. Original first-run outcomes preserved separately.
limitations: Synthetic convenience sample; no population accuracy claim.
Windows compatible GGUF runtime; not native MLX or adapter verification.
Warnings cannot authorize financial or ledger actions.
